seo.description: Join Ankur Salt: three decades of quality-first thinking, five plants on the Gujarat coast, and a team that's still growing.

hero.title: Careers at Ankur Salt
hero.intro: Join a family legacy spanning three decades that's still growing, from Gandhidham's coast to tables across the world.

why.heading: Why Join Ankur Salt
why.subheading: Three decades of putting quality first, built by the Champalal Group and backed by the certifications to prove it.

items.description: Ankur Chemfood Limited has been operating from Gandhidham, Gujarat since 1994. It's part of the Champalal Group, a diversified business with a combined turnover exceeding Rs. 1,000 Crore.
Five manufacturing plants on National Highway 8A, running at a combined capacity of 10 lakh tons per year.
Corporate clients, dealers and distributors trust Ankur Salt, with export access through Kandla and Mundra ports.
Every batch is tested in house against ISO 9001:2015 and FSSC 22000 standards before it ever leaves our plants.

teams.heading: Where You Could Work
teams.subheading: Ankur Salt runs on a few core teams. Here's where the work actually happens.

items.name: Plant Operations & Production
items.description: Running and maintaining our Swiss technology manufacturing lines across five plants on the Gujarat coast.

items.name: Quality Assurance & Food Safety
items.description: Testing every batch in house against ISO 9001:2015 and FSSC 22000 standards before it ever leaves our plants.

items.name: Sales & Distribution
items.description: Managing relationships with our 1,000+ corporate clients, dealers and distributors worldwide.

items.name: Export & Logistics
items.description: Coordinating shipments through Kandla and Mundra ports to international buyers.

items.name: Corporate & Administration
items.description: Supporting the business functions that keep a Champalal Group company running smoothly.

openRoles.heading: Open Roles
openRoles.subheading: Current openings across our plants and corporate team. Apply directly below, or use the form to reach out about a team that isn't listed.

items.title: Production Supervisor
items.description: Oversee daily production runs and ensure manufacturing lines across our plants stay to specification.

items.title: Quality Control Analyst
items.description: Run in house batch testing against ISO 9001:2015 and FSSC 22000 standards before product leaves the plant.

items.title: Export Documentation Executive

items.title: Regional Sales Manager
items.description: Manage and grow relationships with corporate clients, dealers and distributors.

items.title: Accounts Executive

values.heading: What We Value
values.quote: Bharose ki shuruaat: the beginning of trust.
values.text: We're a family business first: three decades of the same commitment to quality that started with Swiss technology and no shortcuts. If you'd rather build something that lasts than chase a trend, you'll fit in here.
